answer: A payout is split and therefore 48% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The jade schedule is applied in vault and ivory publishes each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4824 identities would post 1627 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
